error.message: Knowledge base plugin remote does not answer as an MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:PORT (dial tcp 127.0.0.1:PORT: connect: connection refused). study speaks MCP revision 2025-11-25 over streamable HTTP. Check that the service is running, that it speaks that revision or an earlier one, and that the address is the one of its MCP endpoint: study knowledge-base list shows it, and study knowledge-base add remote --replace --url <URL> changes it
